title: type time as a procedure formal — Session 27 follow-up fence
sourceUrl: internal: STATUS.md §1 — Phase 3 follow-up (type time parameter)
problemDescription: Case 144's original draft had `constant delay_ns : in time` as a procedure formal and the process's declarative-part parse mishandled it, leaving `state` uninitialized so q emitted '0000'. Simplified to a signal-only formal to unblock Phase 3 shipping; this case is the regression fence for the eventual fix. Expected behaviour: identical to 144 (state alternates between '0' and '1' at 20 ns cadence, q alternates '0101'/'1010').
